verdict.rationale: Sandboxed testing is a fair question for an agent-orchestration platform like HumanLayer, but the evidence never describes a sandbox, test mode, or isolation from production data. Per-task worktrees and user-chosen remote hosts (cloud VM, workstation, private network) isolate code changes and compute. They are not a documented sandbox environment. The remote-daemon guidance actually points hosts at the credentials and private services the agent needs.
